scientific_question: Can independent experimental reaction knowledge computed from precursor, composition, process, and thermodynamic variables before a target experiment improve OOD prediction of solid-state synthesis outcomes?

recipient.name: A-Lab target-synthesis campaign
recipient.blocking_issue: A machine-readable table linking every attempted recipe, including failed and partial attempts, to candidate metadata and target-phase outcome has not been verified.

role_limits.precursor_genome_to_a_lab: cross-programme, same-platform validation; not cross-laboratory generality
role_limits.opxrd: post-measurement characterization donor only unless a pre-synthesis candidate mapping is supplied
role_limits.htem: wrong-process control or separate thin-film recipient

go_rule: Launch only after the complete 355-attempt recipient table passes all required-field checks and the target checksum, exclusions, OOD groups, and primary metric are frozen before numerical outcomes are opened.
no_go_rule: Stop if only successful structures are public, failures cannot be linked to recipes, or target XRD is required at prediction time.
